abstract.t: Participation in the IETF is by individuals. This document makes that principle concrete for an environment in which software agents can produce and submit text. Each Datatracker account belongs to one human who has acknowledged the Note Well. Every IETF Contribution is vouched for by one human who is accountable for it. Anonymous Contributions are not accepted, and no human may use more than one identity in the same piece of work. Reading the IETF's work remains open to everyone, with no account or identification required.
